question:
In the European Championship Games, the flags of six countries were arranged on top of pillars in the following way:

The flag of Argentina was to the left of Portugal’s bi-colour and to the right of the flag of France.

The flag of England was to the right of the Portugal flag but to the left of the flag of Germany, which was to the left of the flag of Spain.

Find the two flags that are in the centre.
